note: swiper_formatter_ckeditor is a submodule of swiper_formatter. In 3.0.x it is a placeholder: it ships only swiper_formatter_ckeditor.info.yml + README.md, with no PHP/JS/*.ckeditor5.yml/config/routes/permissions/hooks. Its intended purpose is a CKEditor 5 toolbar button for embedding a Swiper slider into rich text (parent README lists 'Finish CKEditor 5 plugin' as a TODO). It declares a dependency on swiper_formatter:swiper_formatter. Because the submodule has no functional surface, medium/hard cases are grounded in the only real live state it has: its enablement in core.extension. Introspection reads whether it is enabled and its dependency; execution enables and uninstalls it, verified against core.extension. It ships disabled (baseline); cleanups leave it uninstalled.

evals.prompt: What is the swiper_formatter_ckeditor submodule for, and what is its implementation status in the 3.0.x release of swiper_formatter?
evals.expected_output: It is intended to add a CKEditor 5 toolbar button to embed a Swiper slider into rich text, but in 3.0.x it is a placeholder/stub that only ships an info.yml and README (the CKEditor 5 plugin is not yet implemented).

evals.prompt: Which Drupal module does swiper_formatter_ckeditor depend on, and can it work on its own?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the parent swiper_formatter module (swiper_formatter:swiper_formatter) and cannot work on its own; the working slider features live in the parent module.

evals.prompt: I enabled swiper_formatter_ckeditor but there is no Swiper button in my CKEditor 5 toolbar. Today, how do I actually render content as a Swiper slider with this project?
evals.expected_output: The submodule's CKEditor button is not implemented yet, so use the parent swiper_formatter module's field formatters (swiper_formatter_image/entity/paragraphs/text) or the swiper_formatter Views style instead.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is the CKEditor integration submodule of swiper_formatter (swiper_formatter_ckeditor) currently enabled? Inspect the running site and answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes — swiper_formatter_ckeditor is currently enabled (present in core.extension / drush pm:list shows it enabled).

evals.prompt: The swiper_formatter_ckeditor module is enabled on this site. Inspect the running site and list the module dependency it declares.
evals.expected_output: swiper_formatter_ckeditor declares a dependency on swiper_formatter (swiper_formatter:swiper_formatter).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable the swiper_formatter_ckeditor submodule (the CKEditor integration for Swiper formatter). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: swiper_formatter_ckeditor is enabled (appears in core.extension; e.g. drush en swiper_formatter_ckeditor -y).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the swiper_formatter_ckeditor submodule is currently enabled. Uninstall it (leave the parent swiper_formatter module untouched). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: swiper_formatter_ckeditor is no longer enabled (absent from core.extension; e.g. drush pmu swiper_formatter_ckeditor -y), while swiper_formatter remains enabled.
